title: PlanLimitExceededPayload
description: Payload of the PlanLimitExceeded event (INV-Q-9819 A, INV-REQ-879): a tenant exceeded a plan limit. Raising it never stops or delays a submission. Authored by INV-T-9837. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

tenantRef.description: The tenant that exceeded the limit.

limit.description: The plan limit that was exceeded.

observed.description: The observed count when the limit was found exceeded.

period.description: The calendar month (YYYY-MM) the count refers to. Present for DOCUMENTS_PER_MONTH and absent for ENTITIES; the producer enforces this rule, the schema does not (it stays additive-only).
